## Objective
- Complete and deliver a playable game in the repository.

## Requirements
- Build without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly at completion.

## Decisions
- Build **Neon Drift**, a self-contained HTML/CSS/JavaScript canvas arcade-survival game.
- The player pilots a starfighter, fights hostile drones, and collects energy from shards toward a 220-energy goal.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added responsive game page, canvas gameplay, keyboard/mouse/touch controls, waves, enemies, projectiles, shards, HUD, and win/lose/restart overlays.
- Made collected shards the sole source of energy; enemy kills no longer add energy.
- Updated the HUD and objective text to show `Energy / 220` and describe collecting 220 energy.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser tests verified firing, shard collection adding 10 energy, enemy kills granting no energy, winning at 220 energy, and restart/loss flows.
- Inline SVG favicon is present; earlier browser console check reported no errors.

### Active
- Resolve a discrepancy in the latest browser test: immediately after starting, it observed zero shards and no movement, although an earlier test verified movement and shard collection. Recheck animation-frame updates and initial shard spawning after a fresh load.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Fresh-load the game and verify animation updates, movement, firing, and initial shard spawning/collection.
2. Check browser console and `git status`, then report the completed game and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Game page, HUD, objective text, and inline favicon.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: Responsive layout and visual styling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Gameplay logic, scoring, rendering, input, and states.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `game.js`, `index.html`, and `styles.css` as untracked.
- A Python server is running on port 3000; Playwright was used at `http://localhost:3000/`.
- Earlier testing verified movement, firing, and shard pickup; the latest test’s zero-shard/no-movement result remains unexplained.
